addition.item: Added native Joomla administrator modal article selector for Selected Articles source
Added multi-page article selection with persistent selections during browsing
Added integrated article search inside the selector modal
Added administrator article selector optimized for very large Joomla websites
Added automatic article transfer when closing the selector with Done

change.item: Replaced full article preloading with a high-performance two-phase article loading architecture
Administrator article selection now loads only the required records instead of the complete content table
Improved Selected Articles workflow using the native Joomla modal browsing experience
Optimized administrator browsing, searching and pagination for large production environments
Improved overall administrator responsiveness for websites containing hundreds of thousands of articles

fix.item: Fixed administrator timeout when opening Selected Articles on very large Joomla installations
Fixed recursive administrator state initialization affecting the article selection dialog
Fixed excessive memory usage caused by full article list preloading
Fixed article selector stability on high-traffic production websites
Various internal performance and compatibility improvements

note.item: Existing sliders and Selected Articles configurations remain fully compatible
Safe update from all previous 1.0.x releases
Recommended update for all installations, especially large editorial and news websites
Validated on production-scale Joomla installations containing more than 220,000 articles
